technology_name: Tropical Soil Scent: Bottling the Aroma of Rain (Petrichor)
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: Heavy reliance on synthetic aromatic chemical formulations to recreate the natural, widely popular scent of rain on dry earth (petrichor).
description: Identification and extraction of naturally occurring geosmin from a plant-based source instead of conventional soil bacteria. The essential oil extract was chemically validated using Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) to ensure a high-fidelity, crude yet authentic petrichor profile rich in volatile components. This botanical formulation replaces standard petroleum-derived fragrance syntheses with a green, scalable alternative.
applications:
• High-end perfumery and fine fragrance manufacturing formulation collections

• Aromatherapy formulations, functional wellness items, and spa cosmetic lines

• Eco-friendly room misters, diffusers, and premium FMCG home fragrance lines

• Natural raw material sourcing pipelines for international cosmetic brands
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Biotechnology & Life Sciences
